title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file attempt 1 on .moeb/README.md
description: patch_file returned 'old_string not found' when attempting to insert the new README row using the last moeb spec row followed by '### vcs' as the old_string. The content was verified as present via grep_files and read_file_range before the attempt. The write_file fallback successfully applied the change. This is consistent with the open signal 1c2d3e4f-5a6b-4c7d-ae9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f (patch_file CRLF normalization incomplete in exact-string mode).
proposed_resolution: Investigate why patch_file CRLF normalization did not produce a match when grep_files and read_file_range confirmed the old_string content was present in the file. Consider whether the normalize_line_endings function is applied before or after the substring search in patch_file.rs.
